    as.integer(as.character(high_booking)),
    levels = c(0, 1),
    labels = c("low", "high")
  ))

```{r catboost-preprocessing}
airbnb_recipe <- recipe(high_booking ~ ., data = train_clean) %>%
  step_lencode_mixed(zipcode, outcome = vars(high_booking)) %>%
  step_other(property_type, threshold = 0.01) %>%
  step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors(), -host_response_time) %>%
  step_novel(all_nominal_predictors())


```

```{r catboost-hybrid-tune}

# create validation hold out set
set.seed(42)
val_idx    <- sample(nrow(train_clean), size = floor(0.2 * nrow(train_clean)))
val_data   <- train_clean[val_idx, ]
train_data <- train_clean[-val_idx, ]

# prep and bake - val must be baked AFTER prep, using train-only recipe
prepped      <- prep(airbnb_recipe, training = train_data)
train_baked  <- bake(prepped, new_data = train_data) %>% select(-high_booking)
train_labels <- as.integer(train_data$high_booking) - 1L  # "low"=0, "high"=1

val_baked  <- bake(prepped, new_data = val_data) %>% select(-high_booking)
val_labels <- as.integer(val_data$high_booking) - 1L

# CatBoost R detects factor columns automatically from data.frame - no cat_features needed
train_pool <- catboost.load_pool(
  data  = as.data.frame(train_baked),
  label = train_labels
)

val_pool <- catboost.load_pool(
  data  = as.data.frame(val_baked),
  label = val_labels
)

# scoring function - each call runs 5-fold CV and returns mean AUC
cv_score <- function(depth, learning_rate, l2_leaf_reg, subsample, min_data_in_leaf, rsm) {
  params <- list(
    loss_function      = "Logloss",
    eval_metric        = "AUC",
    auto_class_weights = "Balanced",
    iterations         = 1000,
    depth              = as.integer(round(depth)),
    learning_rate      = learning_rate,
    l2_leaf_reg        = l2_leaf_reg,
    od_wait            = 50,
    logging_level      = "Silent",
    rsm                = rsm,
    subsample          = subsample,
    min_data_in_leaf   = as.integer(round(min_data_in_leaf))
  )
  cv <- catboost.cv(pool = train_pool, params = params, fold_count = 5)
  list(Score = max(cv$test.AUC.mean), Pred = 0)
}

# parameter bounds (lo, hi) for each hyperparameter
bounds <- list(
  depth            = c(4,     8),
  learning_rate    = c(0.005, 0.05),
  l2_leaf_reg      = c(1,     20),
  subsample        = c(0.6,   0.95),
  min_data_in_leaf = c(10,    60),
  rsm              = c(0.4,   0.9)
)
param_names <- names(bounds)
n_params    <- length(param_names)

# map unit-cube point [0,1]^d → actual parameter values
scale_params <- function(x_unit) {
  setNames(
    mapply(function(v, nm) bounds[[nm]][1] + v * diff(bounds[[nm]]), x_unit, param_names),
    param_names
  )
}

# evaluate cv_score from a unit-cube row vector
eval_point <- function(x_unit) {
  p <- scale_params(as.numeric(x_unit))
  cv_score(
    depth            = p["depth"],
    learning_rate    = p["learning_rate"],
    l2_leaf_reg      = p["l2_leaf_reg"],
    subsample        = p["subsample"],
    min_data_in_leaf = p["min_data_in_leaf"],
    rsm              = p["rsm"]
  )$Score
}

# Expected Improvement acquisition function
expected_improvement <- function(x_new, gp_model, y_best, xi = 0.01) {
  pred <- predict(gp_model, matrix(as.numeric(x_new), nrow = 1))
  mu   <- pred$Y_hat
  sig  <- sqrt(max(pred$MSE, 1e-10))
  z    <- (mu - y_best - xi) / sig
  max((mu - y_best - xi) * pnorm(z) + sig * dnorm(z), 0)
}

# --- Bayesian optimisation loop (GPfit + lhs, no extra packages needed) ---
n_init <- 10
n_iter <- 20

set.seed(42)
X_all <- randomLHS(n_init, n_params)              # Latin Hypercube initial design
y_all <- apply(X_all, 1, eval_point)

cat(sprintf("Init complete | Best AUC: %.5f\n", max(y_all)))

for (i in seq_len(n_iter)) {
  gp       <- GP_fit(X_all, y_all)               # fit GP surrogate
  y_best   <- max(y_all)
  cands    <- randomLHS(2000, n_params)           # candidate points
  ei_vals  <- apply(cands, 1, function(x) expected_improvement(x, gp, y_best))
  x_next   <- cands[which.max(ei_vals), , drop = FALSE]
  y_next   <- eval_point(x_next)
  X_all    <- rbind(X_all, x_next)
  y_all    <- c(y_all, y_next)
  cat(sprintf("Iter %2d/%d | AUC this iter: %.5f | Best so far: %.5f\n",
              i, n_iter, y_next, max(y_all)))
}

best_params <- as.list(scale_params(X_all[which.max(y_all), ]))
cat("\nBest parameters found:\n")
print(best_params)
```

```{r train-final-model}
final_params <- list(
  loss_function      = "Logloss",
  eval_metric        = "AUC",
  auto_class_weights = "Balanced",
  iterations         = 2000,
  depth              = as.integer(round(best_params$depth)),
  learning_rate      = best_params$learning_rate,
  l2_leaf_reg        = best_params$l2_leaf_reg,
  od_wait            = 50,
  logging_level      = "Silent",
  rsm                = best_params$rsm,
  subsample          = best_params$subsample,
  min_data_in_leaf   = as.integer(round(best_params$min_data_in_leaf))
)

final_fit <- catboost.train(train_pool, val_pool, params = final_params)

```

```{r feature-importance}
# feature importance
importance <- catboost.get_feature_importance(final_fit, train_pool, type = "FeatureImportance")

importance_df <- data.frame(
  feature    = colnames(train_baked),
  importance = importance
) %>%
  arrange(desc(importance))

# print top features
print(importance_df, n = Inf)

# plot
importance_df %>%
  slice_head(n = Inf) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(feature, importance), y = importance)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "CatBoost Feature Importance (all features)", x = NULL, y = "Importance Score")

shap <- catboost.get_feature_importance(final_fit, train_pool, type = "ShapValues")
shap_df <- as.data.frame(shap)
colnames(shap_df) <- c(colnames(train_baked), "bias")
# mean absolute SHAP per feature (overall importance with direction context)
shap_importance <- shap_df %>%
  select(-bias) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ mean(abs(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "feature", values_to = "mean_abs_shap") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_abs_shap))

print(shap_importance, n = Inf)

shap_df %>%
  select(-bias) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ mean(.))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "feature", values_to = "mean_shap") %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(mean_shap))) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

```

```{r vetiver-pin}
library(bonsai)

train_data <- train_data %>% mutate(high_booking = as.factor(high_booking))

boost_spec <- boost_tree(
  trees      = 500,
  tree_depth = best_params$depth,
  learn_rate = best_params$learning_rate,
  min_n      = best_params$min_data_in_leaf
) %>%
  set_engine("catboost",
    l2_leaf_reg        = best_params$l2_leaf_reg,
    subsample          = best_params$subsample,
    auto_class_weights = "Balanced",
    logging_level      = "Silent"
  ) %>%
  set_mode("classification")


wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(airbnb_recipe) %>%
  add_model(boost_spec)

final_fit_wf <- fit(wf, data = train_data)

v <- vetiver_model(final_fit_wf, model_name = "airbnb-catboost-v7")

```
